Ideal Power Match for GEPRC DarkStar22 & High-Performance 4S CineWhoops

The CNHL MiniStar 650mAh 14.8V 4S 70C LiPo Battery with XT30U Plug is perfectly suited for compact 4S CineWhoops like the GEPRC DarkStar22, providing exceptional thrust-to-weight balance and consistent voltage output during fast indoor maneuvers and outdoor cinematic flights. Its compact dimensions and lightweight profile make it a go-to choice for 2–2.5-inch 4S FPV quads that demand both agility and endurance.

Key Advantages of CNHL MiniStar 650mAh 4S for CineWhoop FPV Drones

  • High Burst Power: 70C discharge rate ensures responsive control and punchy acceleration for cinematic flight paths.
  • Lightweight Efficiency: Ideal for sub-100g builds where every gram matters, maintaining stability without voltage sag.
  • XT30U Connector: Reliable current delivery and tight fit for micro FPV drone wiring setups.

Discover more CineWhoop LiPo Batteries from CNHL designed for GEPRC, BETAFPV, and iFlight drones, ensuring your FPV rig performs at its cinematic best.

Notice:

  • For the RC battery, only if the voltage and the plug match, then it will fit.
  • Please stop charging immediately when the cell voltage has been charged to 4.2V (Normal cell voltage is between 3.7V~4.2V).
  • To double make sure safe, please check first whether the battery surface is alright when you get it and whether the voltage is normal before using.
  • If the new battery won’t hold a full charge or loss the charge very quickly in a short time, please use the Balance Charger to charge and recycle several times first.

description.plain:
Power Your FPV Racing with Ovonic 4S 650mAh 80C 14.8V LiPo Battery

Take your FPV racing and freestyle flying to the next level with Ovonic 4S 650mAh 80C 14.8V LiPo battery. Engineered for 90mm to 150mm FPV drones, this battery delivers a high 80C discharge rate, ensuring quick throttle response, stable power output, and minimal voltage sag during intense maneuvers. Whether you're competing on the track or pushing your freestyle quad to its limits, Ovonic LiPo battery provides the reliable performance you need.

Key Features

  • High Discharge Rate for Peak Performance: Equipped with a 80C continuous discharge ensures rapid bursts of power, reducing voltage sag and providing a stable energy supply for high-speed FPV racing and freestyle flying.
  • Compact & Lightweight for Enhanced Agility: With a 650mAh capacity and a 4S (14.8V) configuration, this battery offers the perfect balance between power and flight time, ideal for micro FPV drones where weight matters.
  • Secure and Efficient Power Connection: Equipped with a durable XT30 connector, the battery ensures low resistance and stable current flow, minimizing power loss during extreme flight maneuvers.
  • Reliable Performance & Longer Battery Life: Designed with low internal resistance, this LiPo battery provides consistent voltage levels, reducing heat buildup and enhancing overall lifespan.

Spec of lipo 4s 650mah:

  • Brand: Ovonic
  • Chemistry: Li-polymer
  • Configuration: 4S
  • Voltage(V): 14.8V
  • Capacity(mAh): 650mAh
  • Discharge Rate: 80C
  • Max Burst discharge Rate: 160C
  • Charge Plug: JST-XHR-5P
  • Discharge Plug: XT30 Plug
  • Net Weight(dev.20g): 54g/0.12lb per unite
  • Dimension(±5mm): 59*31*17mm / 2.32*1.32*0.67inch(L*W*H)

More Choice for You:

If you require 4S lipo batteries with other capacities, here are more choices for you to pick.
Such as Lipo 4S 850mah, Lipo 4S 450mah, and also has 2S& 3S lipo batteries for whoops

If your drone is 3S System, 850mAh 3S 80C and 650mah 3S 80C are available, too.

Compatibility

Ovonic 650mAh 80C LiPo battery is a lightweight 4S battery for FPV drone, it perfect match for FPV drones that require a 4S configuration with an XT30 connector, including:

  • FPV Racing Drones: BetaFPV X-Knight 4S, iFlight Alpha A85 4S, Emax Tinyhawk Freestyle 2.
  • Freestyle Drones: GEPRC Smart 4S, Diatone Roma F3, Flywoo Firefly 1.6’’ 4S Nano.
  • CineWhoop Drones: iFlight Protek25, BetaFPV Pavo30, Happymodel Crux35.

Package Content:

  • 4 X Ovonic 650mah 80C FPV Battery 14.8V 4S Lipo Battery Pack with XT30 Plug.
  • 2 x Brand Stickers
  • 1x User Manual.

Please Note:

  1. Use Ovonic official RC Lipo Battery Chargers for optimal charging performance.
  2. Ensure compatibility with both voltage and plug specifications for proper fit.
  3. Cease charging immediately upon reaching 4.2V per cell (normal voltage range: 3.7V~4.2V).
  4. Prioritize safety by inspecting battery condition before each use.
  5. If a new battery doesn't hold a full charge or loses charge rapidly, use a Balance Charger and cycle it several times.
  6. For more safety guidelines, please refer to our Battery Safety Information.

  5. If a new battery doesn't hold a full charge or loses charge rapidly, use a Balance Charger and cycle it several times.
  6. For more safety guidelines, please refer to our Battery Safety Information.

description.plain:
Tattu "R-Line" 4S LiPo Battery Pack 95C (14.8V/650mAh) w/XT-30 Connector

TAT-6504S95XT3

 

This is the Tattu R-Line LiPo Battery Pack. What is R-Line? R-Line is specifically designed for professional FPV racing competitions. It's the selling version of Toppilot batteries. It's also a subsidiary of the Tattu brand. It's got higher capacity, lower internal resistance and lower landing temperatures. They are remarkably more powerful than other graphene batteries. Generally, R-Line batteries have the same specs as our popular Toppilot batteries.

Features:

  • High quality, reliable power
  • Stable automatic stacking technology
  • The most strict single cell capacity, voltage, resistance and discharge curve matching process
  • Superior Japan and Korea Lithium Polymer raw materials
  • Higher C-rating designed for professional FPV racing
  • Higher capacity than comparable size packs

IMPORTANT LITHIUM POLYMER SAFETY INFORMATION

  • DO NOT leave a battery in your model when charging
  • DO NOT leave lithium batteries unattended when charging
  • ALWAYS balance charge lithium battery
  • ALWAYS use a LiPo Safe charging bag/box
  • YOU MUST use a Li-Poly specific charger to charge lithium batteries (NiMH or NiCD only chargers WILL NOT WORK!)
  • YOU MUST not over discharge lithium battery packs
  • READ & UNDERSTAND the instructions carefully before operating this battery


NOTE: When using high energy Li-Polymer Batteries, please do not over-discharge or over-charge batteries as this will result in overheated batteries. Discharging capacity can't exceed 80% of the max capacity of the pack after full charging to ensure a good cycle performance. It is recommended to fully charge a brand new battery before using and only discharge the battery 50% for the first 5 cycles. Always monitor race time and/or set a low voltage warning on ESC (End voltage cannot be lower than 3.2v per cell). Do not use a battery that has too low a voltage. Do not expose batteries to sunshine or store/charge batteries at temperatures above 35°C or in a closed car. The high-temperature environment could cause damage to the pack or make it burst. If the battery becomes hot while fast charging, high current discharging, or racing, do not charge it until it has cooled completely. Wait about 20 mins, then inspect prior to recharging.
